children: Overview
US biopharma firm's Q3 net loss narrowed from prior year
Research and development expenses fell, mainly due to lower CT-202 costs
Cash and cash equivalents expected to fund operations into early Q4 2027
Outlook
Company expects cash to fund operations to early Q4 2027
Context plans to initiate Phase 1b CTIM-76 trial in Q1 2027
Company expects initial CTIM-76 Q3W efficacy data in Q2 2027
Result Drivers
R&D EXPENSES - Q3 research and development expenses declined mainly due to lower CT-202 contract manufacturing and preclinical costs
PERSONNEL COSTS - Higher salaries and share-based compensation drove increased general and administrative expenses
INTEREST INCOME - Lower interest income contributed to reduced other income in Q3
